label: scam
title: 'New number, Grandpa' -- voice-clone grandson asks for a Zelle payment
sources: FBI 'Virtual Kidnapping' warnings + FBI SF warning on AI voice cloning of family members
FTC 2023 alert: scammers use AI to enhance family emergency schemes

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandpa, it's Leo. I lost my phone, this is my new number, save it.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Leo? You sound a little different.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I've got a cold. Listen, I'm in trouble, I rear-ended someone and they want $1,800 cash or they call the police.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can you Zelle it to my friend's account right now? And please don't tell Mom, she'll kill me.
